scenes.narration: A heart, drawn by circles turning on circles. And there is no loop over the circles.

scenes.narration: First, one table of angles. Every speed times every moment, in one outer product. Its cosines and sines are two more tables.

scenes.narration: Then two matrix products turn the points of the heart into circles. Each speed gets one circle and its size. Sort them, biggest first.

scenes.narration: Now chain the circles end to end. One running sum along the circles gives where each one ends, at every moment, all at once.

scenes.narration: So each column is the heart rebuilt from that many circles. One circle gives a circle. With eight, the error is gone.
